stemMd: Square floor tiles have side length 0.5 m. How many tiles are required to cover a 3 m by 4 m floor with no gaps or waste?
explanationMd: The floor area is 12 square metres and each tile covers 0.25 square metre. Dividing 12 by 0.25 gives 48 tiles, also a 6-by-8 arrangement.

distractorRationale.d: This applies an extra factor of two.
distractorRationale.a: This is the floor area's numerical value.
distractorRationale.b: This divides by tile side length rather than tile area.
